intro: A robed figure hunches over a fire, burning what look like official Move Tutor certificates one by one.
speaker: Heretic Tutor
introDialogue: They revoked my license, you know. Said some moves belong to some Pokémon and not to others. NATURE'S LAW, they said.$Nature's law is a filing system, friend. Any creature can learn any technique of its element — the element only asks that you prove your devotion.$Pledge a type. Face what answers. And if you're still standing, I'll teach one of yours something it was never meant to know.
title: The Heretic Tutor
description: Pledge a type, and a legendary Pokémon of that type will test you as a boss battle. Victory earns one of your Pokémon a move of the pledged type — drawn from the type's ENTIRE move list, not its own learnset. The heretic offers a random selection.

1.label: Pledge a Type
1.tooltip:
(+) Defeat the legendary to teach any move of the pledged type
(-) A legendary boss battle
1.selected: Spoken like a true apostate. Now... let's see what the element sends us.

2.label: Report Him
2.tooltip:
(-) No reward
(+) The filing system thanks you
2.selected: Pah! Go on then, run back to the license bureau. The element remembers cowardice.

battleWon: MAGNIFICENT! The element has accepted you. Now — my collection. Choose a technique, and choose its heir.
teachMovePrompt: Which forbidden technique shall be passed down?
outro: The heretic returns to his fire, feeding it another certificate. He seems happier than anyone you've met all day.
